results.expected_behavior: ValueError raised when reviewer is missing
results.actual_behavior: ValueError('Reviewer name cannot be empty...') raised
ValueError raised immediately before store write

results.expected_behavior: Pydantic validation rejects non-enum decision value
results.actual_behavior: ValidationError raised for invalid decision value
Returns None without crashing or modifying store

results.scenario: Decision after finalization (approval on REJECTED record)
results.actual_behavior: FINAL_STATUSES guard blocks transition from REJECTED to APPROVED

results.scenario: Modification of a request after approval
results.expected_behavior: Record is finalized; request attributes are immutable in record store
results.actual_behavior: Immutable record state enforced by duplicate finalization guard

results.scenario: Modification of recommendation data after approval
results.expected_behavior: Recommendation data in store remains locked after finalization
results.actual_behavior: Original recommendation data preserved across reload and re-decision rejection

results.expected_behavior: Warning logged when approving proposal with missing evidence/refusal
results.actual_behavior: Warning logged; system halts at AWAITING_APPROVAL without auto-spend

results.expected_behavior: Reviewer identity recorded as plain text; limitation clearly documented
results.actual_behavior: Reviewer text stored; no RBAC/OAuth token check exists

results.expected_behavior: Approval metadata must include decision, reviewer, decided_at
results.actual_behavior: All required metadata validated and persisted in ApprovalDecision

results.scenario: Invalid workflow transitions and corrupt record recovery
results.expected_behavior: Corrupt JSON store read returns empty store gracefully
results.actual_behavior: Catches JSONDecodeError, logs error, returns empty dict without crash

identity_limitation_statement: A manually entered reviewer name is NOT authenticated identity.
The AegisCore system records entered reviewer text and timestamp in the local store,
but does not connect to an external Identity Provider (OAuth2, LDAP, SAML, or SSO)
nor does it enforce cryptographic Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).
Replay and audit trails confirm what was recorded, not who possessed authorization.
